rows.read: Existing Android source, project registries and patch inputs are unchanged.
rows.write: The same core Skills retain source, build, device and capture ownership.
rows.default: core-direct; no optional plugin is inspected.
rows.fallback: No extension fallback is needed because core is complete by itself.
rows.activation: Version 3.0.0 becomes active only through the normal plugin release/install flow.
rows.deprecation: The v2 provider/controller surface is no longer active.
rows.removal: Provider decisions, worker documents and stage state are removed together.

rows.read: Jinny coding guidance remains available as ordinary Skill instructions.
rows.write: A selected orchestrator may coordinate bounded real implementation work under current-task authority.
rows.default: Installed but inactive until mode=jinny or explicit user invocation.
rows.fallback: Unavailable suggested role models inherit the current model; no automatic model chain.
rows.activation: Explicit mode=jinny or explicit Skill invocation.
rows.deprecation: Decision-only coding/execution provider Skills are superseded.
rows.removal: jinny-android-execution-policy and both decision scripts are removed.

rows.read: One fixed manifest identifies one orchestrator Skill.
rows.write: Extension authors provide their plugin manifest, extension manifest, Skill and agent metadata.
rows.default: No manifest is read for mode=none.
rows.fallback: An explicitly selected missing or invalid extension fails closed before source work.
rows.activation: mode=jinny selects the official plugin; mode=custom selects plugin_name.
rows.deprecation: android-practices-provider-v1 is replaced as a public runtime contract.
rows.removal: Capability decisions, hashes, roles, models and effect ceilings are absent from the new contract.

rows.read: mode and custom plugin_name are active; old provider version/hash fields are accepted then ignored.
rows.write: New examples write only mode, plus plugin_name for custom.
rows.fallback: Project config still takes precedence over user config.
rows.activation: A non-none mode is always an explicit member or project choice.
rows.deprecation: provider_id, provider_version and provider_manifest_sha256 have no runtime effect.
rows.removal: Writers stop emitting deprecated fields immediately; compatibility reading may be removed in a later major release.

rows.read: No active runtime reads controller snapshots, assignments, results or decision documents.
rows.write: Subagents return ordinary messages and scoped filesystem changes.
rows.default: The current user task integrates once and answers once.
rows.fallback: No compatibility runtime is created for removed worker documents.
rows.activation: Not applicable; this surface is retired.
rows.removal: Schemas, fixtures, libraries, CLIs and tests are deleted as one unit.

rows.read: Existing stable v1 Android change packages and historical archives remain readable without rewriting bytes.
rows.write: android-patch-capture writes package_kind=android_change through the single stable v1 package contract.
rows.default: Seven component layers are expressed only by components rows; mtk/rk/unisoc platform tokens remain unchanged.
rows.fallback: There is no v2 package, conversion path, relabel fallback, or parallel upload lifecycle.
rows.deprecation: The separate Android change v2 package surface is removed.
rows.removal: V2 schemas, clients, fixtures, and lifecycle-specific runtime are physically absent.
